沈北城问道：“那你，什么时候把她带出来见见？”
慕迟曜淡淡的回答：“我说了，顺其自然。”
沈北城摊了摊手：“厉衍瑾，我对这个女人越来越好奇了。你说，要不要明天我们两个人，一起去年华别墅见一见？”
沈北城是唯恐天下不乱的性子，见厉衍瑾这么无趣，有点扫兴：“这可是我们慕大总裁身边，第一个有名分的女人，你真的不好奇？”
厉衍瑾往座位上一靠，淡淡的回答：“因为我觉得，你会被慕迟曜撵出来。”
“为了见这位慕太太，那我千方百计，挤破脑袋也要进去啊……”
厉衍瑾笑了笑，他性格清冷，没有沈北城这么的张扬，不怎么想去凑这个热闹，只是好奇而已，还不至于特意去年华别墅跑一趟。
慕迟曜也明白，所以只是扫了沈北城一眼：“你好像很闲？公司最近在德国接下一个合作案子，需要人出差，我看你挺合适的。”
“别别别，我不说了，我想好好的待在慕城……”
三个身价不菲，气质出众，又相貌俊朗的男人坐在一起，无论如何都是会吸引别人的目光。
何况这三个男人，还是慕城最具价值的黄金单身汉。
可惜慕迟曜的保镖却太不近人情，也不解风情，防守得严严实实的，别说去搭讪了，就连靠近都是不可能的事。
慕迟曜平时话就不多，今晚更是不怎么说话，酒一杯接着一杯的往下喝，眼神却始终是十分清明的，没有一点醉意。
一瓶红酒被他一个人喝完了，他才沉声说道：“你们知道，我娶的这个女人，她是谁么？”
厉衍瑾察觉出他语气里的不对劲，眉头一皱：“谁？”
“慕天烨的未婚妻。他把她输给了我。”
沈北城听到之后，惊叫一声：“啊？她？言安希？”
“没，”沈北城摇头，“我听别人说过。毕竟慕天烨的未婚妻，这个身份还是比较很有辨识度的。”
慕迟曜摇了摇杯中的红酒，眼里的神色让人捉摸不透：“既然，慕天烨把她送到我怀里，他敢送，那我就敢收。”
沈北城诧异的说道：“难怪你刚刚说，玩大一点才有趣。慕迟曜，你玩的果然够大啊！”
三个人是多年好友，都清楚很多事情。
慕家的关系，说复杂，其实也不复杂。可是说不复杂，其实也复杂。
慕家上头有一个老爷子，当年也是叱咤风云的商界大佬，现在年纪大了，从慕氏集团退了下来，在慕家养老，每天喝喝茶看看报遛遛狗，虽然看起来悠闲自在，不过问什么事了，可还是有威严在的。
而慕迟曜和慕天烨，其实是同父异母的兄弟。
当年慕父和慕母生下慕迟曜后，慕父却还养了一个情人，两年后情人生下慕天烨。
事情暴露出来之后，慕母和慕父离婚，慕母心灰意冷，在国外安居。慕老爷子十分喜爱这个儿媳妇，也明白这件事是慕父的错。于是一气之下把慕父赶出了慕家，只留下两个孙子，抚养成人。

Chapter 21: The first well-known woman beside President Mu Da
Shen Beicheng asked: "Then when will you bring her out to see her?"
Mu Chi Yao replied calmly: "I said, let nature take its course."
Shen Beicheng spread his hands and said, "Li Yanjin, I'm becoming more and more curious about this woman. Do you think we could meet together at the Huahua Villa tomorrow?"
Shen Beicheng was afraid of chaos in the world. Seeing Li Yanjin so boring, he was a little disappointed: "This is the first well-known woman beside our President Mu Da. Are you really not curious?"
Li Yanjin leaned back in his seat and replied calmly: "Because I think you will be kicked out by Mu Chi Yao."
"In order to see this Mrs. Mu, I will do whatever it takes to get in..."
Li Yanjin smiled. He had a cold personality and was not as flamboyant as Shen Beicheng. He didn't really want to join in the fun. He was just curious and wouldn't go out of his way to go to Hua Villa.
Mu Chi Yao also understood, so he just glanced at Shen Beicheng: "You seem to be very free? The company recently took on a cooperation project in Germany and needs someone to travel. I think you are quite suitable."
"No, no, no, I won't say anything anymore. I want to stay well in Mucheng..."
Three men of high worth, outstanding temperament, and good looks sitting together will attract the attention of others no matter what.
What's more, these three men are the most valuable golden bachelors in Mucheng.
It's a pity that Mu Chi Yao's bodyguards are too inhumane and don't understand the style. They are very defensive. It's impossible to even get close, let alone strike up a conversation.
Mu Chi Yao usually didn't talk much, and he didn't talk much tonight. He drank one glass after another, but his eyes were always very clear, and he was not drunk at all.
After he finished a bottle of red wine, he said in a deep voice: "Do you know who the woman I married is?"
Li Yanjin noticed something was wrong in his tone and frowned: "Who?"
"Mu Tianye's fiancée. He lost her to me."
After Shen Beicheng heard this, he screamed: "Ah? Her? Yan Anxi?"
"No," Shen Beicheng shook his head, "I heard others say it. After all, Mu Tianye's fiancee's identity is quite recognizable."
Mu Chi Yao shook the red wine in his glass, and the look in his eyes was unpredictable: "Since Mu Tianye sent her to my arms, if he dares to give her away, then I dare to accept her."
Shen Beicheng said in surprise: "No wonder you just said that it is more fun to play bigger. Mu Chi Yao, you are really big enough!"
The three have been friends for many years and know many things.
The relationship between the Mu family may be said to be complicated, but in fact it is not complicated at all. But to say it's not complicated is actually complicated.
There is an old man at the head of the Mu family. He was also a powerful business tycoon back then. Now he is older and has retired from the Mu Group. He lives in the Mu family for his retirement. He drinks tea, reads newspaper and walks the dog every day. Although he looks leisurely and relaxed, he still has a dignified character.
Mu Chi Yao and Mu Tianye are actually half-brothers.
After Mu's father and Mu's mother gave birth to Mu Chi Yao, Mu's father also adopted a lover. Two years later, his lover gave birth to Mu Tianye.
After the incident was exposed, Mu's mother and Mu's father divorced. Mu's mother was disheartened and settled abroad. Mr. Mu loves his daughter-in-law very much and understands that this matter is Mu's father's fault. So he drove Mu's father out of the Mu family in anger, leaving only two grandchildren to raise.
